trajectory_summary: This call opens flat, moves through a mechanical verify sequence with almost no rapport or curiosity-building, and ends without a locked appointment — just a promise to text for a bill photo. The one moment of real customer engagement (repeated cost questions) was met with generic program explanation rather than anchored to the customer's own bill, and the call closes on an unresolved, confused customer line that the rep didn't address.
outcome_dispute: The v1 tag is unknown, but this should not be read as a booked or tentative appointment — no day or time was ever offered or agreed to. The rep only secured a promise to text for a bill photo, which is a callback/no_appointment outcome, not a scheduled sit.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep never asked what interested the customer in solar; the call jumps directly from intro into address/homeowner verification and bill/usage questions.
